title: deprecate — asthenosphere

sentences.sentence: He deprecated the low quality of entrants to the profession.
sentences.translation: 他抨击了行业中的滥竽充数。

sentences.sentence: He brought a tremendous infusion of hope to the people.
sentences.translation: 他给人们带来极大的希望。

phrases.translation: 客车；铁道车；（英）火车车厢
货运条件，运输条件；承运条件；运输条款

sentences.sentence: The president-elect followed in an open carriage drawn by six beautiful grey horses.
sentences.translation: 新当选的总统紧随其后，坐着6匹灰色骏马开道的敞篷马车。

sentences.sentence: A lot of teachers expect the situation to worsen over the next few years.
sentences.translation: 许多老师认为接下来的几年情形会更糟。

sentences.sentence: Interfering now could worsen the problem.
sentences.translation: 目前介入可能会使问题更严重。

sentences.sentence: Rembrandt began to work as a professional portraitist about 1631.
sentences.translation: 伦勃朗成为一名职业画家的时间约是1631年。

sentences.sentence: Ben Heine is a painter, illustrator, portraitist, caricaturist and photographer.
sentences.translation: Ben Heine 是一个画家、插画家、肖像画家、漫画家和、摄影家。

sentences.sentence: Both of us had chosen Simmie Knox to paint our portraits: we liked Knox’s lifelike style, and he would be the first African-American portraitist to have his work hang in the White House.
sentences.translation: 我俩都选了西米·诺克斯来为我们画像：我们欣赏他逼真的风格，他也将成为第一位将作品悬挂在白宫的非裔画家。

sentences.sentence: Good breathing is slow, rhythmic and deep.
sentences.translation: 良好的呼吸缓慢、有节奏并且深沉。

phrases.translation: 勘探开发；应用研究，探索研究

sentences.sentence: He’s going to have exploratory surgery on his knee.
sentences.translation: 他的膝盖要做探查性手术。

phrases.translation: 椰子软糖；椰浆；椰子奶油

sentences.sentence: large tropical gardens of coconut palms
sentences.translation: 大型热带椰树园

sentences.sentence: I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
sentences.translation: 我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

sentences.sentence: Good studies are needed to lend credence to the notion that genuine progress can be made in this important field.
sentences.translation: 要有优秀的研究才能使人相信在这一重大领域能取得真正的进步。

sentences.sentence: When nuclear fuel is manufactured it is encased in metal cans.
sentences.translation: 核燃料生产出来时被装在金属罐中。

sentences.sentence: He was bemoaning the fact that lawyers charge so much.
sentences.translation: 他抱怨律师收费太高。

sentences.sentence: I wore a maroon velvet trouser suit that my daughter chose, and most of the village came to the reception.
sentences.translation: 那天，我穿了女儿为我挑选的栗色天鹅绒裤装，村庄里的大多数人都应邀参加了我的婚礼。

sentences.sentence: On an impulse I grab a little maroon dress, pull Christiane from Frau Ballin's arms—she is still wearing only her undergarments—and quickly dress her in it.
sentences.translation: 慌乱中，我随手抓起一件栗色的连衣裙，给在巴林女士怀里的克丽丝汀换上，——可怜的克丽丝汀，她还穿着那件薄衬衣。

phrases.translation: 有法律约束力；受法律约束

sentences.sentence: They are still legally married.
sentences.translation: 他们在法律上仍然是夫妻。

sentences.sentence: Which of them is legally responsible for the accident?
sentences.translation: 他们中谁应该对这起事故负法律责任？

sentences.sentence: a legally binding agreement
sentences.translation: 一份具有法律约束力的协议

sentences.sentence: An inspection was carried out at the school.
sentences.translation: 有人来学校视察了一遍。

phrases.translation: 天然免疫，自然免疫力；先天免疫性
适应性免疫；获得性免疫；继承性免疫
细胞免疫；细胞介导免疫

sentences.sentence: To protect you against small pox or diphtheria, you are vaccinated with a small amount of the toxin, and then your body develops immunity against that toxin.
sentences.translation: 为了避免你长小脓包或得白喉病，所以会给你的身体接种小量毒素，然后你的身体会针对这些毒素产生免疫力。

sentences.sentence: Very few people will have any immunity to this particular combination, which is what gives the concern that this will be a pandemic rather than just a normal seasonal flu outbreak.
sentences.translation: 因为很少有人具备对这种特别的混合病毒的免疫力。 人们因此担心，这将不仅仅是正常的季节性流感疫情，而是一次传染病的大流行。

sentences.sentence: But a new study shows that people with true expertise in a subject have some immunity to the siren song of corporate sponsorship.
sentences.translation: 一项新的研究发现，在某一方面有真才实学的人们对广告赞助商的“糖衣炮弹”有一定的免疫力。

phrases.translation: 关税水平；关税税率水平
保护性关税；保护性税则

sentences.sentence: America wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.
sentences.translation: 美国想要取消电子类产品的关税。

phrases.translation: 限制酶，限制性内切核酸酶

sentences.sentence: a 50 mph speed restriction
sentences.translation: 每小时50英里的限速

sentences.sentence: The mesosphere comprises the rest of the mantle below the asthenosphere.
sentences.translation: 中间圈包括岩流圈以下地幔的其余部分。

sentences.sentence: As the plates spread apart, the lithosphere, or crust, is moved aside like a lid, allowing molten rock from the liquid asthenosphere to seep through.
sentences.translation: 板块分离时，岩石圈或地壳象盖子般移到一旁，液态软流层中的熔岩渗溢而出。

sentences.sentence: Seamounts form from magmatic eruptions, which occur when lava seeps up to the crust through the partially-melted sub-layer, known as the asthenosphere, in the mantle.
sentences.translation: 火山岩透过地幔中部份熔融的软流层渗入到地壳，岩浆喷发，海山由此形成。

text:
英语词汇 · 托福 · 第 263 单元

deprecate
音标：英 /'deprɪkeɪt/  美 /'dɛprəket/
v. 抨击, 反对
例句：He deprecated the low quality of entrants to the profession.
他抨击了行业中的滥竽充数。

infusion
音标：英 /ɪn'fjuːʒ(ə)n/  美 /ɪn'fjuʒn/
n. 灌输
短语：fluid infusion — 补液，输液；点滴注射
短语：infusion pump — 输液泵，抽液泵；灌流泵
短语：capital infusion — 资本输入；扩充资本
例句：He brought a tremendous infusion of hope to the people.
他给人们带来极大的希望。

carriage
音标：英 /'kærɪdʒ/  美 /'kærɪdʒ/
n. 马车, 客车
短语：baby carriage — 婴儿车；童车（等于baby buggy，carriage）
短语：carriage return — n. 回车
短语：carriage way — 车行道
短语：railway carriage — 客车；铁道车；（英）火车车厢
短语：water carriage — n. 水运工具
短语：conditions of carriage — 货运条件，运输条件；承运条件；运输条款
短语：carriage contract — [经]运送契约，运输合同
短语：slide carriage — 滑动溜板；滑座；溜板
例句：The president-elect followed in an open carriage drawn by six beautiful grey horses.
新当选的总统紧随其后，坐着6匹灰色骏马开道的敞篷马车。

worsen
音标：英 /'wɜːs(ə)n/  美 /'wɝsn/
v. 恶化
例句：A lot of teachers expect the situation to worsen over the next few years.
许多老师认为接下来的几年情形会更糟。
例句：Interfering now could worsen the problem.
目前介入可能会使问题更严重。

portraitist
音标：英 /'pɔːtrɪtɪst/  美 /'pɔrtrətɪst/
n. 肖像画家
例句：Rembrandt began to work as a professional portraitist about 1631.
伦勃朗成为一名职业画家的时间约是1631年。
例句：Ben Heine is a painter, illustrator, portraitist, caricaturist and photographer.
Ben Heine 是一个画家、插画家、肖像画家、漫画家和、摄影家。
例句：Both of us had chosen Simmie Knox to paint our portraits: we liked Knox’s lifelike style, and he would be the first African-American portraitist to have his work hang in the White House.
我俩都选了西米·诺克斯来为我们画像：我们欣赏他逼真的风格，他也将成为第一位将作品悬挂在白宫的非裔画家。

rhythmical
音标：英 /'rɪðmɪkəl/  美 /ˈrɪðmɪkl/
adj. 节奏的, 合拍的
例句：Good breathing is slow, rhythmic and deep.
良好的呼吸缓慢、有节奏并且深沉。

exploratory
音标：英 /ɪk'splɒrət(ə)rɪ; ek-/  美 /ɪk'splɔrətɔri/
adj. 勘探的, 探索的
短语：exploratory study — 探索性研究
短语：exploratory factor analysis — 探索性因素分析
短语：exploratory research — 探索性研究
短语：exploratory well — 探井
短语：exploratory development — 勘探开发；应用研究，探索研究
短语：exploratory laparotomy — 开腹探查术
短语：exploratory data analysis — 探索性资料分析
短语：exploratory behavior — 探究行为；探查行为
例句：He’s going to have exploratory surgery on his knee.
他的膝盖要做探查性手术。

coconut
音标：英 /'kəʊkənʌt/  美 /'kokənʌt/
n. 椰子
短语：coconut oil — 椰子油
短语：coconut milk — 椰奶；椰子汁
短语：coconut shell — 椰子壳
短语：coconut tree — [植]椰子树（等于coconut palm）
短语：coconut juice — 椰子汁
短语：coconut water — 椰子汁
短语：coconut cream — 椰子软糖；椰浆；椰子奶油

infancy

n. 幼年

visualize
音标：英 /'vizjuəlaiz/  美 /'vɪʒuəlaɪz/
v. 想象，设想
例句：I tried to visualize the house while he was describing it.
我一边听他描述，一边想象那房子的样子。

credence
音标：英 /'kriːd(ə)ns/  美 /'kridns/
n. 信任
短语：give credence to — 相信…，以…为可信
例句：Good studies are needed to lend credence to the notion that genuine progress can be made in this important field.
要有优秀的研究才能使人相信在这一重大领域能取得真正的进步。

encase
音标：英 /ɪn'keɪs; en-/  美 /ɪn'kes/
v. 装入, 包住
例句：When nuclear fuel is manufactured it is encased in metal cans.
核燃料生产出来时被装在金属罐中。

bemoan
音标：英 /bɪ'məʊn/  美 /bɪ'mon/
v. 哀叹
例句：He was bemoaning the fact that lawyers charge so much.
他抱怨律师收费太高。

maroon
音标：英 /mə'ruːn/  美 /mə'run/
n. 栗色 a栗色的
例句：I wore a maroon velvet trouser suit that my daughter chose, and most of the village came to the reception.
那天，我穿了女儿为我挑选的栗色天鹅绒裤装，村庄里的大多数人都应邀参加了我的婚礼。
例句：On an impulse I grab a little maroon dress, pull Christiane from Frau Ballin's arms—she is still wearing only her undergarments—and quickly dress her in it.
慌乱中，我随手抓起一件栗色的连衣裙，给在巴林女士怀里的克丽丝汀换上，——可怜的克丽丝汀，她还穿着那件薄衬衣。

legally
音标：英 /'li:gəli/  美 /'li:gəli/
adv. 法律上, 合法地
短语：legally binding — 有法律约束力；受法律约束
例句：They are still legally married.
他们在法律上仍然是夫妻。
例句：Which of them is legally responsible for the accident?
他们中谁应该对这起事故负法律责任？
例句：a legally binding agreement
一份具有法律约束力的协议

inspection
音标：英 /ɪn'spekʃn/  美 /ɪn'spɛkʃən/
n. 检查, 视察
短语：quality inspection — 质量检查
短语：inspection system — 检查体系
短语：commodity inspection — 商品检验
短语：safety inspection — 安全检验
短语：inspection certificate — 检验证明书；检查证明
短语：inspection equipment — 检验设备；检查仪器
短语：inspection report — 检验报告
短语：visual inspection — 目测；目检；外观检验
短语：inspection team — 检查组
短语：commodity inspection bureau — 商品检验局
短语：ultrasonic inspection — 超声波检查
短语：product inspection — 产品检验
短语：on-site inspection — 现场检查；现场检验
短语：inspection department — 检验部门
短语：sampling inspection — 抽样检验，取样检查
短语：inspection station — 检查站
短语：quarantine inspection — 检疫
短语：automatic inspection — 自动检查；自动检验
短语：factory inspection — 厂内检查；工厂检验
短语：final inspection — 最后检查；最终检查
例句：An inspection was carried out at the school.
有人来学校视察了一遍。

immunity
音标：英 /ɪ'mjuːnɪtɪ/  美 /ɪ'mjʊnəti/
n. 免疫性
短语：cellular immunity — [医]细胞免疫
短语：immunity system — 免疫系统
短语：humoral immunity — 体液免疫
短语：noise immunity — 抗干扰度（性）
短语：innate immunity — 先天免疫；自然免疫
短语：natural immunity — 天然免疫，自然免疫力；先天免疫性
短语：diplomatic immunity — n. 外交豁免权
短语：adaptive immunity — 适应性免疫；获得性免疫；继承性免疫
短语：cell-mediated immunity — 细胞免疫；细胞介导免疫
短语：acquired immunity — [医]后天免疫；获得免疫性
短语：sovereign immunity — n. 主权豁免权
短语：protective immunity — 保护性免疫
短语：transplantation immunity — 移植免疫
例句：To protect you against small pox or diphtheria, you are vaccinated with a small amount of the toxin, and then your body develops immunity against that toxin.
为了避免你长小脓包或得白喉病，所以会给你的身体接种小量毒素，然后你的身体会针对这些毒素产生免疫力。
例句：Very few people will have any immunity to this particular combination, which is what gives the concern that this will be a pandemic rather than just a normal seasonal flu outbreak.
因为很少有人具备对这种特别的混合病毒的免疫力。 人们因此担心，这将不仅仅是正常的季节性流感疫情，而是一次传染病的大流行。

一项新的研究发现，在某一方面有真才实学的人们对广告赞助商的“糖衣炮弹”有一定的免疫力。

tariff
音标：英 /'tærɪf/  美 /'tærɪf/
n. 关税
短语：import tariff — 进口关税
短语：tariff barrier — 关税壁垒
短语：tariff rate — 关税税率；协定费率
短语：export tariff — 出口关税
短语：tariff policy — [经]关税政策
短语：tariff system — 关税制度；收捷制
短语：tariff quota — 关税配额
短语：preferential tariff — 优惠税率；特惠关税
短语：tariff level — 关税水平；关税税率水平
短语：customs tariff — 关税率；海关税则
短语：protective tariff — 保护性关税；保护性税则
短语：tariff reform — 关税改革
短语：tariff structure — 关税结构；价格结构
短语：tariff concession — 关税减让
短语：ad valorem tariff — 从价税
短语：tariff act — 关税法
例句：America wants to eliminate tariffs on items such as electronics.
美国想要取消电子类产品的关税。

restriction
音标：英 /rɪ'strɪkʃ(ə)n/  美 /rɪ'strɪkʃən/
n. 限制, 约束

例句：a 50 mph speed restriction
每小时50英里的限速

asthenosphere
音标：英 /əs'θenəsfɪə/  美 /æs'θinə,sfɪr/
n. 岩流圈
例句：The mesosphere comprises the rest of the mantle below the asthenosphere.
中间圈包括岩流圈以下地幔的其余部分。
例句：As the plates spread apart, the lithosphere, or crust, is moved aside like a lid, allowing molten rock from the liquid asthenosphere to seep through.
板块分离时，岩石圈或地壳象盖子般移到一旁，液态软流层中的熔岩渗溢而出。
例句：Seamounts form from magmatic eruptions, which occur when lava seeps up to the crust through the partially-melted sub-layer, known as the asthenosphere, in the mantle.
火山岩透过地幔中部份熔融的软流层渗入到地壳，岩浆喷发，海山由此形成。
